values.title: Clarity over complexity
values.description: I aim for interfaces and code that make sense at a glance — no unnecessary layers.

values.title: Function + Feel — never one without the other
values.description: What works should also feel good. I design for both usability and delight.

values.title: Testing like a user, building like a dev
values.description: I instinctively test for friction and usability — not just technical correctness.

values.title: Adaptability, ownership, and the hunger to improve
values.description: I evolve with the project, take initiative, and keep pushing quality forward.

values.title: Full-circle thinking — data in, experience out
values.description: I don’t ship unless every layer is solid — the data model, the API contract, the integration, the UI, and the polish.

values.title: API design is UX design
values.description: How data is structured and served shapes how the UI behaves. I treat API contracts as first-class design decisions.

values.title: Security is a default, not an afterthought
values.description: I build with security in mind from the very first line — validation, auth, and more.

values.title: Pixel-perfect attention to detail
values.description: 1px off? I see it. And fix it. Transitions, spacing, states — they all matter.

values.title: I own the integration layer
values.description: Stripe, Supabase, Google Maps, LLM APIs, Socket.IO — I wire these into products and make sure the data flows cleanly end-to-end.

values.title: Independence with collaboration where it matters
values.description: I move fast on my own, but collaborate deeply where alignment is key.

values.title: Reliable delivery with pride and thoroughness
values.description: I build every feature like it’s mine — and make sure it works, beautifully.

values.title: I translate tech for people, not just to them
values.description: Whether working with medical staff or small business owners, I turn complex decisions into plain language — and their needs into software that actually fits.

values.title: I figure out undocumented things — alone
values.description: At Oracle, I taught myself a tool with almost no documentation. I became the person others came to when they were stuck. Initiative is a skill, not a trait.

values.title: Accessibility is craftsmanship, not compliance
values.description: I pushed a Lighthouse accessibility score from 40 to 80 — not because I had to, but because every user deserves a working interface.
